en.headline: Husband arrested after wife reports theft of Rolex and handbags worth HK$450,000 in Yau…
en.dek: A 40-year-old man was detained after his 34-year-old wife reported that a Rolex watch and three designer bags had gone missing from their Ocean One flat on Saturday morning.
body: Police arrested a 40-year-old man surnamed Lam on Saturday on suspicion of theft after his wife reported the loss of luxury items from their home in Yau Tong.

The 34-year-old woman surnamed Chan told officers at about 8.38am that a Rolex watch valued at around HK$150,000, two Hermès handbags and one Chanel handbag, together worth roughly HK$300,000, were missing from their residence at Ocean One, 6 Shung Shun Street. The total reported loss was about HK$450,000.

Responding officers attended the scene and, after an initial investigation, arrested the husband. He is being held for enquiries. The case has been passed to the District Crime Squad of Kwun Tong Police District.

zh.headline: 油塘丈夫被拘 妻報稱家中勞力士及手袋失竊涉約四十五萬元
zh.dek: 三十四歲女子今早報稱油塘Ocean One單位內勞力士手錶及三個名牌手袋失竊，警方拘捕其四十歲丈夫。
body: 警方周六拘捕一名四十歲林姓男子，涉嫌盜竊。其妻報稱油塘住所內名貴物品失竊。
三十四歲陳姓女子約上午八時三十八分向警方表示，家中位於崇信街6號Ocean One的單位內，一只約值十五萬元的勞力士手錶、兩個愛馬仕手袋及一個香奈兒手袋失蹤，三個手袋合共約值三十萬元，總損失約四十五萬元。
到場警員初步調查後拘捕其丈夫，現正扣留查問。案件交由觀塘警區重案組跟進。
